prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 6 tests with 2 wins, though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +1.2% after noise correction across 3 tests with 1 win, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, averaging +0.1% after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_flow; adoption, new_screen; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +2.9% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.2% after noise correction, 6 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick friend companion carousel layout: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full visual carousel with animated companion preview cards. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%) with high median completion time (89s).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet companion naming ceremony screen: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after sign-in before transitioning to the desktop home intro. (why: The finish step suffers a 29% drop-off rate (71.0% completion). Adding an explicit naming step deepens emotional bond before desktop placement.)
2: [home, redesign] Split layout workspace setup waiting screen: Redesign the generation waiting screen into a split layout showcasing live progress metrics and pet hatching animation. (why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s), leading users to drop off while waiting for pet creation.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Cloud sync reassurance note on sign in: Add a prominent hint to the sign-in screen explaining that signing in saves pet progress to the cloud across desktop app restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [finish, redesign] Stage layout desktop pet controls showcase: Redesign the home intro screen into a showcase stage highlighting desktop shortcut interactions and tray controls. (why: Support received multiple tickets asking how to hide, control, or interact with pets after completing onboarding.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop habitat backdrop selection screen: Insert a desktop habitat selection screen into the adoption flow where users choose their pet's default desktop perch background. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%). Giving users agency over their pet's environment boosts adoption completion.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Setup path clarity and duration copy tweak: Clarify path choice copy by distinguishing quick preset companion pick from custom photo companion creation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing decision paralysis on path selection.)
7: [home, wait_info] Background generation toggle on waiting screen: Enable background notify when ready toggle and dynamic wait time estimation on the generation waiting screen. (why: High waiting mean time of 2336s indicates users abandon active waiting windows without knowing they can wait in background.)
8: [adoption, layout] Compact photo upload screen with preview frame: Switch upload photos screen layout to compact mode and embed an explicit reference image preview frame. (why: Support logged 3 tickets regarding failed photo customization or wrong visual output.)
